headline: Bullpen unravels late as Phillies fall to Cardinals
recap: The Phillies dropped a 2-0 decision to the Cardinals in St. Louis on Tuesday, wasting six scoreless innings from Cristopher Sanchez, who struck out seven without walking a batter. St. Louis broke through against the bullpen: Everson Pereira's solo home run off Tim Mayza in the seventh and Masyn Winn's RBI single off Alex McFarlane (0-1) in the eighth accounted for both runs. Philadelphia managed five hits but stranded eight runners, including four walks from Bryce Harper and Trea Turner combined.
The loss dropped the Phillies to 64-57, second in the NL East, 8.5 games behind the division-leading Atlanta Braves and riding a one-game losing streak.

Philadelphia closes out the series in St. Louis this afternoon, with Zack Wheeler starting opposite Cardinals right-hander Kyle Leahy; first pitch is scheduled for 2:15 PM ET at Busch Stadium. DraftKings has the Phillies as a -158 favorite on the moneyline.
